issues.title: Broken Cross-Module Reference (AC-SD-01)
issues.why: AC-SD-01 inherits AC-CL-* from a relative path '../02-coding-guidelines/...' which is not provided in the context, leaving the AI coder without the mandatory naming and typing rules.
issues.fix: Provide the content of spec/02-coding-guidelines/01-cross-language/97-acceptance-criteria.md in the context or inline the critical AC-CL rules.

issues.title: Schema Discrepancy in Fundamentals vs AC
issues.why: 01-fundamentals.md defines 'Project' and 'Database' tables with snake_case columns (e.g., 'ProjectId', 'DisplayName', 'EntityId' are okay, but 'SizeBytes', 'RecordCount' are used while AC-SD-28 requires specific PascalCase and types like TEXT for timestamps).
issues.fix: Update 01-fundamentals.md SQL blocks to match the exact schema floor and PascalCase requirements defined in AC-SD-28.

issues.title: Truncated Implementation Examples
issues.why: The 01-fundamentals.md file is truncated at the 90KB cap, cutting off the 'Cache Database Pattern' and potentially other worked Go examples needed for 100% confidence.
issues.fix: Move critical implementation snippets into the parent 97-acceptance-criteria.md or ensure they are within the first 80KB of the module.
